summary: Tested Project List fixes. Bug 2 (index tag removal) fully fixed. Bug 1 (identical card sizes) PARTIALLY fixed — widths & image wrapper dimensions now identical across all 5 cards, but total card HEIGHTS still differ by ~31px because titles on 'Investing Made Fun' and 'Flipkart' cards wrap to 2 lines while other 3 titles fit on 1 line. All regression checks pass (marquee scrolls, hover pauses, kicker/title/arrow present, no console errors).

ui_bugs.issue: Card heights are NOT identical. Widths=[500,500,500,500,500] (Δ=0px ✓) but heights=[385.27, 385.27, 385.27, 416.06, 416.06] (Δ≈31px ✗). Investing Made Fun and Flipkart cards are taller because their longer titles wrap to 2 lines. Image wrapper (498x280, ratio 1.779) is identical across all cards — the divergence is caused by the title text block, not the image wrapper.

verified_fixes: BUG 2: No [data-testid^=project-index-] elements exist (count=0). No card contains '01·05'/'01/05'-style text.
Image wrapper aspect ratio = 1.779 (within 1.77–1.79) on all 5 cards.
Computed object-fit = 'contain' on all 5 card images.
Marquee auto-scrolls (Δleft ≈ 79px over 3s) and hover-pauses (Δleft = 0 while hovering).
Each card contains kicker, [data-testid=project-title-<id>], and arrow SVG path 'M4 12h14M14 6l6 6-6 6'.
Nav / Hero / Footer render without console errors.
action_items: Force the title block to have a fixed height (e.g., min-h / h with line-clamp-2) so titles that fit on 1 line still reserve the same vertical space as 2-line titles. Suggested: add 'min-h-[3.5rem] line-clamp-2' (or equivalent based on font-size/line-height) to [data-testid=project-title-*] wrapper. Alternatively set the outer article to a fixed height (e.g., h-[420px]) so all 5 cards measure identically via getBoundingClientRect.
critical_code_review_comments: Card container uses content-driven height. Any variability in title length or footer text will cascade into inconsistent card heights inside a horizontal marquee — this is exactly what the user reported. Enforce a fixed height on the article OR clamp the title to a fixed line count.
react-fast-marquee duplicates children — testid count is 4 (2 copies × 2 marquee passes) rather than 2. Not a bug, just noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes card height parity (title clamp or fixed article height), re-run the getBoundingClientRect assertion on all 5 cards and confirm max-min height < 1px.
